name: Ryuu Asaio
source: The current class president. Regarded highly be everyone for his cool demeanor under pressure, his charming looks, and his sharp intellect. Ryuu runs numerous clubs and sports, letting him meet many people but develop friendships with few. When Ahri arrives at his school, he sees a potential rival for the first time in his school career.
